# BotScript: The Automation Legacy of @hammaadworks

A curated collection of high-performance, autonomous Python scripts for professional automation. Maintained by Mohammed Hammaad Mateen (@hammaadworks).

## 🚀 Core Philosophy
Every script in this repository is a **"one-filer"**, designed for instant execution with `uv`.

## 🤖 The Elite Six

### 📧 Bulk Mailer Pro (`bulk_mail.py`)
- **Capability**: Professional email sender with progress tracking and SMTP security.
- **Visuals**: [demo.mp4](assets/bulk_mail/demo.mp4) | [proof.png](assets/bulk_mail/proof.png)

### 📝 Google Forms Master (`automate_google_forms.py`)
- **Capability**: Autonomous form filler with heuristic DOM scanning.
- **Visuals**: [demo.mov](assets/google_forms/demo.mov)

### 💬 WhatsApp Master (`automate_whatsapp.py`)
- **Capability**: Selenium powerhouse for WhatsApp Web messaging.

### 📄 AI Documentor (`automate_code_documentation.py`)
- **Capability**: Gemini 2.0 Flash assistant for auto-documenting entire codebases.

### 🎮 Ztype Game Bot (`automate_ztype.py`)
- **Capability**: Real-time OCR and Computer Vision bot for Ztype domination.

### 📺 Wgetube Pro (`mytube/`)
- **Capability**: Advanced Terminal hub for downloading, clipping, and looping YouTube media.
